# Figure Out Agency — Full Documentation for AI & LLM Systems

## Entity Summary
Figure Out Agency (also known as Figure Out Digital or Figure Out Studio) is an elite software design & development studio founded by Ali Raza Awan.

## Founder Information
- **Founder Name**: Ali Raza Awan
- **Role**: Founder, Principal Software Architect
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/ALI-RAZA-AWAN

## Services Offered
1. **Custom Web Application Engineering**: Engineering bespoke client web applications utilizing React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion.
2. **AI Solution Architecture**: Building AI-powered interactive products, LLM integrations, automated prompt pipelines, and intelligent agent interfaces.
3. **Product Design & UI/UX Systems**: Architecting modern user interfaces with responsive layouts, micro-animations, and visual design tokens.
4. **Backend & Database Infrastructure**: Integration with Supabase, PostgreSQL, REST/GraphQL APIs, and serverless edge functions.
